note: Visible tests cover case, punctuation next to a space, an apostrophe inside a word and text of only punctuation; only the hidden tests cover punctuation with no space around it, hyphens and dashes, the underscore, punctuation outside ASCII, apostrophes at the edges and the order of the keys.

twin_breaks.rule: Every character that is not a letter or a digit separates words, with or without spaces around it
`_` is not part of a word
